# V372 — Integrated telemetry control on the actual reference runtime

Date: 2026-09-10. Library maintenance, AUTHORED reference integration over exact official components. TEST-05 runtime qualification PASS; canonical Preflight/checkpoint closure is recorded at the end of this document when observed. Prior contract is43/48,5BLOCKED until that closure. This evidence does not close TEST-02,03,07,09 or the broader T2809 recovery/release task.

## Unchanged acceptance oracle and exercised target

TEST-05: “Verifica privacidad/operación integrada del target; reutiliza TEST-10 contador y TEST-11 política local sin confundirlos con exportación, retención o salud del sink.” The target is the actual composed return-refund main executable, not a mock worker. Its canonical CLI and dedicated finite reference CLI use the same reporter. A new owned PostgreSQL18.6 cluster receives explicitly synthetic seed rows and the selected migrations with constraints/triggers enabled. No private corpus, project history, external provider account, refund execution, notification, deployment or paid service is authorized or used.

The existing maintenance contract excludes real deployments/accounts/data without authority. This target therefore closes the library integration oracle once the canonical gates pass; consumer production TLS identities, service accounts, operator alert routing, retention budgets, recovery, security/load and acceptance remain mandatory. A local reference PASS is never production certification. GO_OBSERVABILITY_CORE0.3.2 remains CANDIDATE and was not adopted by reputation.

| Oracle component | Actual observation |
|---|---|
| Integrated export | Real host main emits25logs,25traces,25metric records; authenticated official-source Collector persists all three and Prometheus scrapes its real endpoint. |
| Correlation | Exact log trace/span IDs and corresponding spans checked across4active host instances;250metric points/40counter-histogram series checked. |
| Monotonicity | Per-instance cumulative counters/histograms preserve start timestamps, nondecreasing event times/counts and fixed bucket semantics; repeated errors followed by graceful cancellation are observed. |
| Privacy/diagnosis | Five closed operational outcomes only; private-marker scan and explicit field schemas reject payload/error/DSN leakage. `handled` means a worker step returned, not successful refund/payment. |
| Authentication | TLS1.3 mutual authentication rejects absent/rogue client identities on OTLP, Collector metrics and Prometheus API. A distinct loopback health probe is plain HTTP. Pinned config/CA/client cert/key hashes checked before the first claim. |
| Sink failure | Actual Collector process is stopped: host exits1 with static diagnostic, further claims stop, original launch reservation cannot replay. Prometheus loss alert fires and clears after restart. Partial three-signal delivery is unknown and never replayed. |
| Operational alert | Synthetic table temporarily renamed inside the owned cluster induces a real worker DB error; rule evaluation becomes firing and later recovers. Missing provider remains blocked with zero provider transmission. |
| Retention |2000observations/8CLI instances in2.3073662seconds;1MiB rotation,2backup limit and1day expiry verified, including expired synthetic fixture removal.3retained files each below1MiB, exact bytes unchanged after Collector restart. |
| Shutdown | Five host attempts include tampered config rejection; four actual active instances exercise inherited trusted stop event or sink-failure exit. Every owned process stopped at the end. |

No power-loss durability, PITR, remote failover or full Prometheus TSDB disk cap is claimed. Prometheus retention64MB/1h is configuration, not a strict total-directory bound. The2000-observation test is bounded reference stress, not a production capacity SLO.

## Canonical reusable code and provenance

OFFICIAL_UPSTREAM_ACQUISITION_CORE0.4.82 materializes40files,188source IDs/21profiles. Only the new telemetry profile and lock inventory changed; existing transport behavior is unchanged. GO_OFFICIAL_RETURN_REFUND_WORKER0.1.5 materializes23files, adding a bounded authenticated OTLP/HTTP reporter, native stop protocol, regressions and finite reference CLI/certificate generator. WINDOWS_REFERENCE_TELEMETRY_RUNTIME0.1.0 materializes13AUTHOREDfiles and is opt-in, REBUILD_VERIFIED / CONDITIONED for a trusted local Windows account. Conditions are satisfied by the exact runtime lock and acceptance run recorded here; arbitrary runtime hashes are not admission.

All new application/supervisor code remains AUTHORED under LicenseRef-Workspace-Owner. Microsoft Win32, Go TLS, OTLP and Prometheus contracts govern the behavior but do not turn this glue into vendor implementation. Native supervision is a trusted-account Job Object protocol, not hostile same-user isolation or a production service installer. Existing conditioned V345–V351 proofs remain supporting evidence.

Reporter uses a single10..3000ms finite deadline including queueing,16KiB request/1KiB response bounds, no proxy/redirect/retry, strict OTLP acknowledgement decoding and fixed outcomes. Counter/histogram overflow and unexpected native stop watcher failure fail closed. Certificates are generated with Go standard library Ed25519, explicit SKI/AKI,2hour expiry, exclusive synchronized private-key creation; CA signing key is never written. Reference work directory ACL admits current user and SYSTEM. No private keys are embedded in this report.

Reference runner is Python3.14 standard library. Its whole runtime lock is independently SHA-bound and bounded to64KiB; executable/migration/seed inventory is verified before a new workspace or process. The reference environment has exactly declared keys; service bootstrap adds only fixed Windows COMSPEC, not inherited PATH, proxies, OTEL or provider environment. Owned database data_directory is verified before any mutation. Example lock deliberately fails admission.

Collector0.160.0 source commit cd3455cf3a7f672208140b1ebb1581c542b2b0ed, archive3939353bytes/SHA7e60b3d4520e15ae2ebeaf93b1c775ad40a548651688bf75b37ca1c8d777d770. Both acquired through the reconstructed official profile and root Apache-2.0 license hashes. Approval actor is the agent under the user's maintenance authorization, not an invented human signature.

Contrib0.160.0 whole archive982f20b8a8e8a2569fab3e27cf8b008e8a5080c1 is excluded from the Windows source profile because of a test symlink. No flattening or silent skipping. Selected fileexporter/prometheusexporter/healthcheck Go module origins bind to that official commit; exact Go ZIP hashes and sumdb-backed checksums are preserved. Full core/contrib release graphs had advisories and their binaries were neither downloaded nor executed. The chosen minimal distribution is generated by the official source-built OCB with only declared components and file configuration provider.

Go1.26.8 builds with GOTOOLCHAIN=local, GOWORK=off, CGO_ENABLED=0, -mod=readonly and -trimpath. OCB source dependency-only adaptation upgrades x/sys0.41.0→0.44.0; its32module query returns0findings. OCB version output is(devel), never represented as an official prebuilt binary. Collector generated lock upgrades x/crypto0.55.0→0.56.0; Prometheus lock upgrades x/crypto0.54.0→0.56.0 and grpc1.82.1→1.83.2. No official component runtime Go code was edited. Collector uses -tags=grpcnotrace; Prometheus/promtool omit builtinassets and claim API/rules/CLI only.

The complete runtime query contains387entries (384module versions plus Go stdlib/toolchain and Prometheus main v0.314.0, corresponding to the3.14.0 release commit). Three advisory records remain at module level: GO-2026-5932 (unmaintained x/crypto/openpgp) and GO-2022-0635/0646 (aws-sdk-go s3crypto). Exact affected packages are absent from all five compiled import closures and binary symbols; disposition NOT_PRESENT applies only to these hashes. This is not a zero-finding module graph and does not close integral security TEST-03. Changed component selection, build tags, source, platform or locks reopen this triage.

384actual runtime module versions have preserved LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE identities,149unique license/notice texts. Module h1 checksums, license bytes/hashes, exact build info and imports bind this review to the selected binaries. Retain notices on redistribution; the portable pack includes authored source, not third-party runtime binaries.

## Assurance by narrow implementation dimension

Functional/correctness: real main/CLI, DB-induced error and recorded fixed outcomes. Reliability: failure stop, no replay, finite process/output budgets, restart retention and native watcher regressions. Security/privacy: mTLS negatives, strict payload/config schemas, local ACL, fixed environment and artifact-bound SCA triage. Performance: finite2000-observation stress with bounded cardinality/rotation, no production SLO claim. Operability: actual rule evaluation, diagnostic signals, graceful shutdown and recovery. Maintainability/portability:13/23file Markdown reconstructions, canonical hashes, opt-in profile and recurring policy tests. License/provenance: exact source revisions, declared adaptations and149license/notice texts. Global project implementation_assurance stays BLOCKED until its other controls close; no dimension is promoted merely by compilation.

## Reproduction

Use a new trusted Windows x64 reference workspace. Reconstruct the three canonical packs and compose FRANCHISE_COMPLETE_PACK_PLAN.md into an absent destination. Acquire the exact two source snapshots using the telemetry inspection profile and recorded authorization fields. Build OCB from its exact official cmd/builder source plus preserved go.mod/go.sum adaptation; generate the Collector with the preserved builder configuration after replacing only its owned output_path. Build Collector with preserved generated files/go.mod/go.sum and Prometheus/promtool from the exact source plus recorded lock changes using the flags above. Reconstruct/build both refund command packages. Compare all binary hashes and Go module verification before execution. The portable runtime-lock.example.json is intentionally not a runnable trusted lock: materialize a fresh lock from the exact verified executables, consumer migrations and seed bytes, independently hash it, then run:

```text
python -B reference_telemetry/run_reference_runtime.py --runtime-lock <verified-local-lock> --runtime-lock-sha256 <independently-computed-digest> --consumer <fresh-composed-consumer> --work-root <owned-new-reference-root>
```

Raw evidence below contains original local paths as data for audit; portable instructions require no machine-specific directory. Private keys and database files are excluded. Each record is exact original bytes encoded as gzip+base64 with raw SHA-256 and byte length; decode base64, gzip-decompress and verify the raw hash. Failed records are explicitly historical, not PASS receipts.
